system: Tekken 6 (PSP, 2009) — customization item NAME records extracted from the decrypted DATA401 bulk

source.store: mhvnsnt/western-heart release tekken6-recon-20261016, t6-recon-backup.tar, SHA-256 2c738b24f46395960e463fd03c637b038a0942590c0055b9ef3fe1bc9d77afcc (verified byte-identical on download 2026-10-20)

record_format: u32 rec_size (total record bytes) + u8 item_idx + char name[rec_size-5] ASCII null-padded (format per teardown/tekken6-customization-research.md; re-validated first-hand 2026-10-20)

scan.method: prefix scan for u32 rec_size 6..64 + strict record validation (printable ASCII name, null-only padding) + consecutive-run chaining
scan.item_idx_range: 1-160 (160 distinct values; index is per-table/per-category — the same idx recurs across language tables and categories)
scan.note: Names below are the name field with trailing padding spaces stripped. All language tables are included (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, and others) because the tables interleave in unmapped bulk regions and language boundaries are not clean; lang_id attribution per record was not recoverable from the record format alone. The tekken-mining lane's earlier scan validated 10,495 records with looser clustering; this stricter re-scan (names >= 2 chars, runs >= 4) yields 9,440 — both scans agree on the format and on the largest run size (32).
